juno: TL;DR from the postmortem: condensed action list below. We need owners + JIRA links by EOD Mon. Quick please.

juno: Actions (short):
A) implement pre-warm hook + graceful connection drain on gen-service (reduce cold-start tail)
B) stagger health-checks + add exponential backoff + jitter across AZs
C) create eviction dashboard + night-threshold alert + runbook entry for repeat thrash
D) produce deterministic synthetic prompt suite + nightly regression job (fail builds on quality regressions)
E) update on-call runbook: explicit handoff steps, escalation SLOs, 90d rotation cadence

juno: I'll track these in the follow-ups page and run weekly check-ins until closed.

rahul: I'll take A and C. Creating tickets now.
rahul: INF-4905 created for pre-warm + drain. ETA 2026-04-11. Acceptance: 99.9p cold-start <200ms in perf harness.
rahul: INF-4906 created for eviction dashboard + alert. ETA 2026-04-01. Alert: fire when eviction_rate >5% for 15m AND p95 latency delta >50ms.

carmen: I'll own B and E (health-check jitter + runbook). Splitting into two tickets and will coordinate with eng-infra.
carmen: INF-4907 (health-checks) ETA 2026-04-06. INF-4908 (runbook rotation) ETA 2026-04-15.

marta: I'll take D (synthetic suite). Will work with Applied ML + QA to pick prompts and metrics.
marta: INF-4909 created, ETA 2026-04-13. Goal: nightly job with deterministic seed + quality/regression thresholds.

ops-bot: Postmortem doc updated: https://docs.redwood/internal/postmortems/gen-service-2026-03 " + " follow-ups appended.

juno: Please paste the JIRA links into the follow-ups doc and set due dates. Also add backup owners (1 per ticket). I'll run a short weekly sync until these are closed.

rahul: INF-4905: PR opened for minimal pre-warm prototype, attaching perf harness. Tagging @eng-runtime for kernel/quant changes. Backup owner @carmen.

carmen: INF-4907: added staggered backoff table and default jitter params. Requesting SRE review on acceptable limits. Backup owner @marta.

marta: INF-4909: draft prompt list pushed (long-history chats, multi-embed batches). QA runbook will include golden-output diffs + latency thresholds. Will share tomorrow.

rahul: RACI notes: A(R=Rahul, A=EngRuntime, C=SRE+EngInfra, I=PM/Support). C(R=Carmen, A=SRE, C=EngRuntime, I=Support).

carmen: For E (runbook), propose adding an explicit handoff checklist and a 2-week buddy system for rotation. Also add which Jira to attach when incidents get reopened.

juno: Good. Scheduling a 25m owners sync (owners + SRE + QA): Thu 09:00. If conflicts call them out.

rahul: Thu 09 conflicts for me, can we do Thu 09:45?

carmen: 09:45 works.

marta: 09:45 ok for me too.

juno: Moved to Thu 09:45. Invite sent.
